Name: Yuzu More Ingredients
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[font=Courier New][b][color=#ea9999][size=5]Yuzu More Ingredients[/size][/color][/b]
[b][size=4]Supports Cornucopia and Wildflour. [/size][/b][/font]

[size=4][font=Courier New][b]Adds shared ingredients and supplies for Yuzu’s More food series.
Use alongside [color=#ffd966]Yuzu More Craftables[/color], then choose the food mods you want. You don’t need to install the entire series.
Some recipes use ingredients from [color=#f1c232]Cornucopia[/color] and [color=#ffd966]Wildflour’s Atelier Goods[/color]. [/b][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Courier New][b]Check each food mod’s requirements before installing.[/b][/font][/size]


[font=Courier New][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/color]
[/b][/font]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Download and unzip the file.[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Place the extracted folder directly into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Keep the folder structure as it is.
[color=#ff0000][u]Do not move or extract the individual mod folders from their parent folder.[/u][/color][/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: More Ingredients Core
Manifest.Description: Secret Woods spring-water collection and bottle support for More Ingredients. Legacy UniqueID retained for compatibility.
Manifest.Author: Yuzu

Manifest.Name: More Ingredients Forage Core
Manifest.Description: Spawns and preserves Secret Woods chestnuts.
Manifest.Author: Yuzu17

Manifest.Name: More Ingredients
Manifest.Description: Shared cooking ingredients and supplies for the More food series.
Manifest.Author: Yuzu17
